items.definition:
a slow-moving mollusc; a bullet
A slug left a slimy trail on the leaf.

the highest female singing voice
The opera singer was a talented soprano.

an electronic document in which data is arranged in rows and columns
I organized the data in a spreadsheet.

the residential part of a town or city, away from the main business area
They decided to go uptown for dinner.

a venomous snake
Be careful; there might be a viper in the tall grass.

a slight line or fold in something, especially fabric or skin
She smoothed out the wrinkle in her dress.

a wild pig
A wild boar was spotted in the forest.

the edible, outer layer of a grain
Many breakfast cereals contain bran for fiber.

a person who operates a film or television camera
The cameraman filmed the entire event.

a short journey undertaken in order to deliver or collect something, especially on someone else's behalf
I need to run a few errands this afternoon.

a person, country, or company that sends goods or services to another country for sale
The country is a major exporter of oil.

a sudden intense feeling of fear
The loud noise gave me a fright.

A type of dog; a region in Canada.
My friend has a friendly Labrador.

toilet (informal, British English).
Excuse me, where's the loo?

A cocktail made with tequila, triple sec, and lime juice.
She ordered a frozen margarita with salt.

A plant with complex, often showy flowers.
She received a beautiful orchid as a gift.

A person trained to give emergency medical care to people who are injured or ill.
The paramedics arrived quickly at the scene of the accident.

a carbohydrate found in plants, used as food or for stiffening clothes
Potatoes are a good source of starch.

a person who surfs, especially on a surfboard
The surfer rode the big wave all the way to the shore.

a small mistake in typing or printing
I found a typo on the first page of the book.

a place where wine is made
We visited a beautiful winery in Napa Valley.

a piece of land where aircraft can take off and land
The small plane landed safely on the airfield.

a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, especially a rabbit, as a dwelling
The rabbit disappeared into its burrow.

a stringed musical instrument of the violin family, larger than a viola and tuned an octave below it
She plays the cello beautifully.

a type of tea made with milk and spices
I'd like a hot chai latte, please.

a person employed to manage a household
The hotel employs several housekeepers.

small vehicle
They rented a go-kart at the amusement park.

worker
Many laborers were hired to build the new bridge.

driver of a car
The police warned motorists about the icy road conditions.

the marks, such as commas and periods, used in writing to separate sentences and clauses and make meaning clearer
Correct punctuation is essential for clear writing.

writing materials, such as paper and envelopes
I bought some new stationery for writing letters.

a soft, white food made from soybeans
I like to add tofu to my stir-fry.

a wooden walkway
We walked along the boardwalk by the beach.

a person who climbs
The mountain climber reached the summit.

a fraction with a denominator of a power of 10
The number 0.5 is a decimal.

a person who is impractical or idealistic
He was always a dreamer, imagining a better world.

the faculty of seeing; vision
Her eyesight is getting worse with age.

a person or thing that finds something
The finder of the lost wallet returned it to its owner.

the material of a floor
They decided to replace the old flooring with new tiles.

the part of a person's arm from the elbow to the wrist
He broke his forearm playing football.

a type of tight-fitting trousers
She wore black leggings with a long sweater.

a native or inhabitant of Paris
The Parisian greeted us with a friendly smile.

a sudden sideways slide
The car went into a skid on the icy road.

a small, thin, sharp piece of wood, glass, or similar material broken off from a larger piece
I got a splinter in my finger from the old fence.

a person who watches something
The bird watcher patiently waited for the rare species to appear.

a stringed musical instrument
She learned to play the banjo at a young age.

a device that produces a current of air
He used a leaf blower to clear the driveway quickly.

a flowerless plant that has feathery or leafy fronds
The forest floor was covered with lush green ferns.

the end of a finger
She touched the delicate flower with her fingertip.

a list of goods sent or services provided, with a statement of the sum due for these
Please send me an invoice for the services rendered.

a type of cocktail
He ordered a dry martini with an olive.

A herb with crinkly or flat leaves, used for flavoring or garnishing food.
She chopped some fresh parsley to sprinkle over the soup.

A nocturnal mammal with a black mask-like marking across its eyes and a bushy, ringed tail.
A raccoon was rummaging through the trash cans.

A person who saves money or something else.
She's a careful saver and always puts money aside for a rainy day.

A place where ships are built or repaired.
The new warship was built in the local shipyard.

the act of sending out invoices or charging for services
The company handles all the billing for its clients.

a score of one stroke under par on a hole in golf
She made a birdie on the final hole to win the tournament.

a large wild ox with a shaggy mane and a humped back
Herds of bison once roamed the North American plains.

a person who makes and repairs things in iron by hand
The blacksmith hammered the hot metal into shape.

a unit of digital information, typically consisting of eight bits
A kilobyte is equal to 1024 bytes.

the state of being clean or free from dirt
Cleanliness is important for good health.

imaginary line around the Earth
The equator divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

woman engaged to be married
He introduced his fiancée to his family at dinner.

large stinging wasp
A hornet flew into the room and everyone ducked.
